title: sync script: timeout 900 lacks -k; hung TERM-ignoring session wedges the sync loop forever
description: Reviewer kimi-k3 passes 1.4/3.3 (converged). sync-beads-workers.sh:110 'timeout 900 opencode run' sends TERM then waits indefinitely if the child ignores it; the :99 comment's 15-min guarantee does not hold, and rc=124 path (:316) then races surviving grandchildren writing the worktree. Fix: timeout -k <grace> 900.
